title: Report: findings first
question: How should the churn report open?

options.label: Verdict first
options.description: One-sentence finding and the number behind it, then the evidence. Best for readers who stop after the opening.

options.label: Timeline first
options.description: Walk the quarter in order and end on the finding. Best when the sequence is the story.

options.label: Findings plus side notes
options.description: Findings in the main column, caveats and data sources in a narrow aside.

content: The report goes to the retention lead on Monday. Churn rose 1.2 points in Q3, driven by one cohort of annual plans. Most readers will read the opening and decide whether to continue.
